# ECN-2026-009 Change notice - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

Reason for change
- Validation testing identified inconsistent clamping preload retention on the mandrel clamp assembly of EQ-P1-L2-RR01 during production shifts. Root cause analysis traced the issue to previous fastener installation practice and an undocumented target clamp bolt torque in the maintenance workpack. To standardize assembly and restore clamping integrity, the mandrel clamp bolt torque is formally set to 395 N·m. This change aligns maintenance, operations, and quality verification steps across P1-L2.

Affected items
- EQ-P1-L2-RR01 mandrel clamp assembly and associated fasteners.
- Preventive maintenance procedures and torque verification records for milling operations on line P1-L2.
- Work instructions and operator checklists that reference clamp torque for the ring rolling mill.

Implementation
- Update the maintenance task in MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 to specify mandrel clamp bolt torque = 395 N·m and require torque verification at each clamp reseat operation. Attach a torque verification checklist to the task.
- Revise SOP-P1-L2-03 to include the torque confirmation step during setup and changeover for EQ-P1-L2-RR01. Operators will record the applied torque and sign off prior to rolling.
- Maintenance crew to perform one immediate corrective action: re-torque the mandrel clamp bolts on EQ-P1-L2-RR01 to 395 N·m and document results in the equipment history log. Subsequent PMs will include torque verification per MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1.
- Quality will inspect the first production shift after implementation to confirm clamp integrity and record findings under ECN-2026-041 traceability.

Approvals
- Engineering approval: [signature on file] — implements torque specification and updates to MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1.
- Maintenance approval: [signature on file] — acknowledges procedure updates and execution plan.
- Operations approval: [signature on file] — acknowledges SOP-P1-L2-03 updates and operator responsibilities.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-041
- MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1
- SOP-P1-L2-03
